ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.19-JS1.1S1-JD2 TailTrace is a diagnostic build based on JS1.1S1 Slow Search 256 for RimWorld 1.5. Gameplay search behavior is unchanged from JS1.1S1. After 600 main-thread frames, the first JobGiver package taking at least 64 ms arms a one-shot bounded TailTrace window on the next frame. JD2 temporarily instruments WorkGiver phases plus GenClosest, Reachability, RegionTraverser and scanner-source calls, records ClosestThingReachable ThingRequest versus custom search-set shape and candidate-size buckets, and stops after 8 slow packages or 128 total captured packages. Temporary detours are then removed automatically. JR1/JR1.1 remain retired and the JS1.1R ReachProfile rolling fuse is unchanged.
